en.t: She had been saved unexpectedly, but this only deepened her sorrow.

units.source_text: 思量今后如何度日，觉得此身实甚可嫌。

en.t: As she wondered how she would live from then on, she felt that her own existence was truly hateful.

units.source_text: 每逢月明之夜，老尼僧等总是吟咏艳歌，回忆往昔，讲种种故事。

en.t: Whenever the moon shone brightly at night, the old nuns would recite love songs, remember the past, and tell all kinds of stories.

units.source_text: 但浮舟无法应对，只是独自沉思。

en.t: But Ukifune could not respond to them; she only sat alone, lost in thought.
